sources.title: davidheineman/opd-teacher-Q2.5I-Cornfield-step149
sources.snippet: Overview Model Overview This model, opd-teacher-Q2.5I-Cornfield-step149, is a specialized Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct teacher model with 1.5 billion parameters and a 32768 token context length. Developed by davidheineman, it is specifically trained for on-policy distillation (OPD) experiments within a 32-environment setup.
